metadata.title: Vietnam Education Institutions Master Dataset
metadata.purpose: Seed/reference dataset for a database of universities, academies, colleges, intermediate/vocational schools and international higher-education presence in Vietnam.
metadata.important_warning: Vietnam does not currently expose one single public machine-readable national endpoint containing every active vocational training centre and every other organisation registered for vocational education. Records marked needs_recheck are directory/code-list evidence and must not be interpreted as confirmed active in September 2026.
metadata.deduplication: Normalized Vietnamese names; exact normalized duplicates merged, sources combined.
metadata.ownership_policy: Ownership is left null when not verified. No public/private label is guessed from the school name.
metadata.international_policy: Foreign university alliance/TNE/joint-delivery programmes are retained but flagged is_independent_institution=false so they are not confused with legally independent universities.
metadata.governance_note: governing_body means the direct supervisory/parent authority where applicable. It is intentionally separate from national_education_regulator. Domestic private institutions normally have no direct governing ministry; their governing_body is null unless a legally verified owner/parent authority is recorded.
metadata.country_note: Domestic institutions default to Vietnam. Foreign/international records use country_of_origin_name and ISO-2 when origin is known.
